title: rclone lsd -P deadlocks
body:

#### The associated forum post URL from `https://forum.rclone.org`

n/a

#### What is the problem you are having with rclone?

Commands `ls`, `lsd`, `lsd` do not display anything & hang up when called under PowerShell v7.3.5.
Nonetheless, all 3 commands work OK when called from Windows 10 regular command prompt.

NB :
- command `lsjson` works OK under PowerShell v7.3.5 & the regular command prompt;
- identical behaviour when using PowerShell v7.3.5 directly or within Windows Terminal v1.17.11461.0;
- other commands do not appear affected eg. `sync` & `serve` work OK under PowerShell v7.3.5

#### What is your rclone version (output from `rclone version`)

v1.63.0

#### Which OS you are using and how many bits (e.g. Windows 7, 64 bit)

Windows 10, 64-bit

#### Which cloud storage system are you using? (e.g. Google Drive)

Same behaviour with local, OneDrive, Swift storages.

#### The command you were trying to run (e.g. `rclone copy /tmp remote:tmp`)

`rclone ls local:d `, `rclone lsd local:d`, `rclone lsf local:d`, `rclone ls remote:d `, `rclone lsd remote:d`, `rclone lsf remote:d`

#### A log from the command with the `-vv` flag (e.g. output from `rclone -vv copy /tmp remote:tmp`)
